title: Work IQ: long-running tasks for A2A and MCP agents
summary: Hold: the controls table says spending-policy automation is not documented, but Microsoft documents a beta Graph API that creates policies covering Work IQ. The roadmap facts and cited admin paths match; the briefing should also acknowledge conflicting Microsoft guidance about default write access.
